svg.title: Results that support a scoped claim
svg.desc: The measured limiter is visible in the task distributions: in repeat 0, native-form median fell from 114.80 ms to 18.47 ms, while full-WebKit HTML/JSON retrieval still took about 115–118 ms in the candidate. Those retrievals limit the aggregate matched throughput. Event-sensitive waits remove native-form polling delay; closed-tab lifetime fixes also have separate before/after retained-process evidence. Their individual contributions to the whole gain were not isolated.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
